issues.finding: Windows CRLF inline CSS was hashed before HTML parsing normalised it to LF. The browser correctly blocked the mismatched stylesheet, causing an oversized unstyled logo.
issues.fix: Canonicalise CSS and JavaScript line endings before rendering and hashing. Keep strict hash-bound CSP unchanged.
issues.regression: Five focused native/offline/brand platform tests passed; the retained first browser run loaded the pre-fix shell. Final browser verification is recorded separately.
